Subtitle: NA
Dsec: There was no gimmick, just a normal 1v1.

Subtitle: Old in the New
Dsec: This tournament only allowed weapons that had a main/sub/special combo that could exist in Splatoon 2.

Subtitle: Seeing Red
Dsec: This tournament only allowd weapons that are red.

Subtitle: What a Flex
Dsec: This tournament prevent players from using a main weapon multiple times in one set. This has now become one of the rotating gimmicks of BFS.

Subtitle: SPLOOSH KABOOM
Dsec: This tournament only allowed weapons that go "KABOOM" (i.e. Explosher and Blaster) along with Sploosh. The name is a refrence to the Wind Waker Minigame Sploosh Kaboom.

Subtitle: Double or Nothing
Dsec: This tournament required teams to use the same exact weapon and kit as each other. A modified version of this gimmick is now a standard BFS gimmick.

Subtitle: My Happy Place
Dsec: This tournament legalized only weapons that Finazon 4 or 5 starred at the time of running this bracket.

Subtitle: Back to Basics
Dsec: This tournament made Splatoon 3 feel like it was 1.0.0 again.

Subtitle: A New Era
Dsec: This tournament happened when 3rd kits were released. They were the only weapons allowed.

Subtitle: I'm Flying!
Dsec: This tournament only allowed inkjet and zipcaster weapons.

Subtitle: Old and the New
Dsec: This tournament forced teams to have one player use a weapon from Season 3 and prior and the other from Season 4 onwards. This is now a standard BFS gimmick.

Subtitle: A Nightmare End
Dsec: This tournament was completely normal, until it wasn't. Grand Finals was only Lemuria Hub. You're welcome term and yoshii <3

Subtitle: Weapon Evolution
Dsec: Initially, 7 random weapons were legal. Each Round, 7 more weapons were added into the legal weapon pool.

Subtitle: Now Introducing
Dsec: This tournament allowed only new weapons from Splatoon 3 or New Squiffer.

Subtitle: BONK!
Dsec: BONK! - Legal weapons from this tourney (weapons that could be melee only).

Subtitle: That Can't Miss
Dsec: This tournament sure had a lot of AOE going around; it was also only TC.

Subtitle: That Sucks
Dsec: This tournament made players use ink vac before it was cool.

Subtitle: One Shot
Dsec: This tournament was predicting the one shot weapon meta since August 2025.

Subtitle: Shifting Tides
Dsec: Players could only use weapons that got changed in Splatoon 3 balance patch v10.1.0. This does not include weapons that had a points for special change, but does include weapons that had their specials get buffed/nerfed. During this tournament it was found that term was a Sorella Brella addict, however that was already pretty obvious.

Subtitle: Whats 9+10?
Dsec: This tournament combined the gimmicks and legalized all weapons from BFS 9 and BFS 10 (A New Era and I'm Flying!).

Subtitle: So Far Away
